rationale.edition: All 32 changed files live under shared open-source paths — web/src/** (dashboards, lib, locales), tests/ui-testing/**, and scripts/translations — none under enterprise-owned directories (enterprise/, o2_enterprise/, src/enterprise/). No enterprise keywords (cipher, SSO, SAML, RBAC, SDR, logo-management) appear in the changed paths, so the change is classified OSS.
rationale.skip: Not skipping. No tests-added label or skip comment was provided, and the change alters user-facing Dashboard UI (settings drawers, tab badges, empty states, grid drag/resize), so it is not docs/CI-only.
